description: This file orchestrates post-build tasks for a runtime environment, including copying static assets, generating alias files, and invoking various build steps to prepare runtime dependencies for deployment.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns the list of output destination paths for static extension assets, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension assets from source to destination paths, creating necessary directories and optionally warning if assets are missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Creates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime scripts matching a specific naming pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Executes the main post-build steps: copying SDK root alias, plugin metadata, channel catalog, setting up runtime dependencies, generating aliases, and copying assets.
